lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Silver mist hangs in the morning air
Soft echoes dance upon the water's face
A single lantern glows like a hidden star
Time slows down in this sacred space

The heavy earth begins to drift away
The light of dusk starts to gold the gray

Whispers of the moon are drifting by
A breath of peace in every hollow stone
I find a home in the great unknown
